title: Your doctor needs your insurance login
scenario: A caller says they are from your clinic’s billing team and a rejected claim can be fixed if you confirm your insurance portal login. They correctly name your doctor and recent appointment.

answers.A: Offer to provide the insurance member ID through the clinic’s secure portal instead of sharing a login.
answers.B: Share the login if the caller can confirm your appointment details.
answers.C: End the call and use the clinic portal or known clinic number to ask what information is actually needed.

explanation: A clinic may need insurance information, but it should not need your insurer password. Familiar medical context can be stolen or guessed.
proTip: Organizations may need account data; they do not need your account password.
